newsitem.title: USA: CME hogs, pork bellies end lower but above lows.
newsitem.headline: CME hogs, pork bellies end lower but above lows.

text.p: A late buy order in July CME pork bellies resulted in a sharp rally from lows but prices fell back at the close to finish with sharp losses and a limit loss in August's closing range. Short covering pared losses in hog futures by the close, traders said.

Pork bellies closed 1.625 to 3.000 cents per lb lower with July off the least at 83.050 cents. August settled down 2.675 but was offered limit down at the bell. Distant November also ended limit down.
Hog futures ended 0.175 to 1.300 lower with July off 0.400 at 83.250 and December off the least.
Pork belly futures were under pressure from the start as a weak tone to cash bellies offset a bullish CME out-of-town report Tuesday.
Cash belly quotes slipped to as low as $85 per cwt after rising to $90 on Tuesday, the highest since April 30. The price rise cut off demand, traders said.
"Again, 90-cent (per lb) stopped demand," one trader said.
The late rally in July may have come from projections of reduced hog slaughter over the long four-day holiday weekend, they added.
